contentText: PRESS REVIEW – Thursday, January 8: US immigration authorities ICE kill a woman in Minneapolis in "self-defence" amidst anti-ICE protests in the city. It brings back painful reminders of George Floyd's death in 2020. Also, the press explores what Europe can do to stop Donald Trump seizing Greenland (hint, not much). Finally, it's shear mania as dozens of sheep invade a supermarket in Germany's Baa-varia region.
